user.title: Ilmy services and location
user.description:
Enter the base URLs of the Ilmy services (the defaults work for most users), then continue to sign in with your ilmy account in the browser.

Your sign-in token is forwarded to these URLs, so https:// is required unless the host is localhost or a private (LAN) address.

data_description.hijri_url: https:// required (http only for localhost/private hosts)
data_description.hadith_url: https:// required (http only for localhost/private hosts)
data_description.quran_url: https:// required (http only for localhost/private hosts)

confirm_urls.title: Confirm custom service hosts

data_description.hadith_book: Collection used for the hadith of the day

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect — check the URLs and that the services are reachable
error.invalid_auth: The sign-in token was rejected — please try again
error.invalid_url: Invalid URL — use an http(s) URL with a valid host and no embedded credentials
error.https_required: https:// is required for public hosts — your sign-in token would otherwise be sent unencrypted (http is allowed only for localhost/private addresses)
